cmdlist.001:
📋 *Basic commands* (1/4)

🛍️ *Product / Catalog*
• `{0}` — new product
• `{1}` — with cost, stock and category
• `category banao {3}` — new category
• `catalog` — see the list
• `edit product: {2} - 2000` — change the price
• `delete product {2}` — remove a product
• `stock {2} 20` or `stock {2} +10` — set or add stock
cmdlist.002:
📋 *Basic commands* (2/4)

👤 *Customer*
• `customer add Sara, Model Town, 03001234567`
• `Sara ka phone 03001234567` / `Sara ka address ...` / `Sara ka city ...` — correct details

🧾 *Order*
• `{4}` — just write it, the bot makes a draft (Save or yes)
• `order for Sara`, then send the items
• `walkin {2} 2` — counter sale, no phone needed
• `order 12 advance 500` / `order 12 delivery 300` / `edit order 12`
cmdlist.003:
📋 *Basic commands* (3/4)

🚚 *Status and payment*
• `mark 3 shipped` / `mark 3 delivered` / `mark 3 returned`
• `mark 3 paid` — payment received
• `cancel 3` — cancel the order
• `undo` — reverse the last action

💰 *Expenses and cash*
• `expense 500 packaging` / `expenses today`
• `create discount: EID10 10%`
• `drawer open 5000` / `cash in 200 note`
cmdlist.004:
📋 *Basic commands* (4/4)

📊 *Reports*
• `orders today` · `aaj ka hisaab` · `profit` · `margin` · `monthly net`

ℹ️ *Help*
• `help` · `menu` · `guide` · `kya karun` — the next step
• `commands` — see this list again
